text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn's Animal Health unit said Thursday it had acquired Pherrovet Group, a producer and distributor of animal health products based in Malmo, Sweden.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The drug manufacturer, formed through a merger of Pharmacia AB of Sweden and The Upjohn Co. in November 1995, said the acquisition allows it to regain ownership of a number of animal health products once owned by Pharmacia AB.
Two of these products are Hylartil, used to treat joint dysfunction in horses, and Hogpax, a tranquilliser for swine.
The acquisition also strengthens Pharmacia & Upjohn's presence in Denmark and marks its entry into Finland, Sweden and Norway, where Pherrovet also has subsidiaries, the company said in a statement.
Pharmacia & Upjohn's stock was unchanged at $42.25 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
